hooks.notes: @tecton-astryx/core/utils/safe-url.js: navigation policy for the link, resource policy (no data:) for image sources.
A node icon is the `icon` slot; a string icon stays an image URL (upstream back-compat).

differences.text: An unlinked citation is role="img" with the citation name instead of an aria-label on a bare span (which assistive technology ignores); the number badge therefore reads "Citation 3: Title" instead of just "3".

`source.icon` accepts an image URL only; a node icon is the icon slot, and source.src wins over the legacy string. Flat attributes source-title, source-url and source-src are an addition for declarative markup.
An image source that fails to load or whose URL is refused by the resource policy (data:, script schemes) is dropped instead of leaving a broken image; upstream renders the unconditionally.

requests.reason: Component tests feed runKeyboardSuite from parity.json (import parity from './parity.json'), but the project include does not cover JSON files, so tsc -b fails with TS6307. Tests use import.meta.glob until the include is widened.
